headline: Sources: Steelers' contract philosophy led to Joey Porter Jr. trade
summary: The Steelers' philosophy of avoiding second-year contract guarantees was a factor in their inability to reach a deal with Joey Porter Jr., sourced told NFL Network.

headline: Cowboys Interested In Joey Porter Jr. Extension; CB To Play In Week 4

headline: Panthers place WR Xavier Legette on IR with knee injury
summary: The Carolina Panthers have placed 2024 first-round pick Xavier Legette on injured reserve ahead of Sunday's prime-time matchup against the Detroit Lions.
